text:
lena: Heads-up — prepping a slim kernel swap for the night window. Switching to engine bundle kernel v3.12-zipkin (sha: a1b2c3d). Need a deploybot pin + 1% canary. Bake 22:30 UTC, full cutover 23:00 if smoke OK. @nina - release can you draft short notes? @harry can you watch metrics?
harry: on it. i'll watch latency, errors, and token-diff. any specific smoke tests?
lena: Run quick suite: latency P95, eval correctness (prompt-suite/nightly.json), kvcache sanity. i'll drop the commands below.
lena: ```
./tools/smoke.sh --suite prompt-suite/nightly.json --canary 0.01 --engine sha:a1b2c3d
curl -XPOST https://deploybot/release -d '{"bundle":"engine-v3.12-zipkin","pin":"true","ttl":3600}'
```
deploybot: release request received for engine-v3.12-zipkin — creating pin. Requester: lena. TTL: 3600s. Scheduled: 2025-08-12T22:30:00Z. Tracking: https://deploy/redwood/rel/1749453210 :gear:
omar: QA confirms quant artifacts: qv2-rr sha: ffeedd11, qv2-int8 sha: 1122aabb. We ran long-form eval — saw a 1.6% token-diff on v1 but within our soft threshold. i'll annotate in the notes.
nina - release: i'll add a changelog snippet. rollback criteria proposal: token-diff >2% OR latency P95 increase >8% sustained for 10m triggers rollback.
harry: starting smoke now. baseline p95 145ms -> canary 148ms. no errors in first 2m. kvcache hit steady.
lena: good. after 10m, if stable, shift to 10% slice and let deploybot ramp. keep pin TTL short so we can unpin fast. :thumbsup:
deploybot: Canary slice 1% started. Targets: us-west-1:120 nodes. Observability: https://console/redwood/metrics/1749453210
ops-bot: Alert rule 'engine-telemetry-smoke' firing — token-diff 1.9% over 5m. Severity: medium. @nina FYI :warning:
nina - release: token-diff approaching threshold. hold ramp. @lena please pause additional ramps until we investigate.
lena: pausing ramp. @omar can you run a detailed diff and paste the top divergences?
omar: quick excerpt:
```
1) prompt id: 9ab3 - truncate/missing trailing sentence in canary output (diff score 0.83)
2) prompt id: 1f4c - paraphrase shift (acceptable) (0.76)
3) prompt id: e7d1 - numeric rounding diff (0.65)
```
harry: logs show microtime jitter on a subset of hosts, tied to a new kernel path allocation. isolating nodes and starting drains on affected hosts.
deploybot: Pin updated: engine-v3.12-zipkin -> pinned on 30 nodes. TTL extended to 7200s by lena.
nina - release: i'll draft the release note: "Engine v3.12-zipkin: kernel optimizations + quant v2 parity. Small divergence on long-form evals observed; monitoring live. Rollback criteria documented."
lena: decision: continue with a reduced ramp to 5% but exclude drained hosts. @harry start 5% when ready.
harry: starting 5% ramp now. observing metrics.
deploybot: Ramp event: 1% -> 5% at 2025-08-12T22:45:00Z. Rollback window open until 23:30 UTC.
harry: 5% steady for 7m. P95 +2.5%, token-diff 1.8% (below nina threshold). no error spike.
nina - release: OK to proceed with full rollout plan, keep the playbook active. Reminder: immediate rollback if token-diff >2% OR P95 >8% for 10m. i'll tag support for possible customer comms.
lena: thanks all. i'll update the internal release doc with the diffs and link the smoke logs. ping @channel if anything regresses. :memo:
